test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_short_circuit_branches (a Int64, b Int32, c UInt32, n Nullable(Int32)) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_short_circuit_branches SELECT toInt64(cityHash64(number)), if(number % 20 = 0, 0, toInt32(number % 1000) - 500), toUInt32(number % 977 + 1), if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, toInt32(number % 300)) FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(if(b != 0, intDiv(a, b), 0) + c) FROM jit_short_circuit_branches SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(multiIf(b = 0, 0, b = -1, -a, intDiv(a, b)) + c) FROM jit_short_circuit_branches SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT count() FROM jit_short_circuit_branches WHERE b != 0 AND modulo(a, b) > 3 SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(n = 0 OR intDiv(a, n) > 1) FROM jit_short_circuit_branches SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
